assets.scenes: TOP: In a smoky 1920s garage she steps protectively between an out-of-focus ally and a shadowy claw, draws back her wrench for a decisive counterattack. MIDDLE: SAME mechanic and garage, wrench swing shatters a threatening shadow shape, sharp warm gold and cool blue highlights, steady confident gaze, one bounded impact burst; no magic wielded by her.
